calls.title: Aug 10, 07:05 AM
calls.summary: The discussion centered on the recommended upgrade to GrowthBook version 5.0, which introduces AI-driven functionalities, flag governance, and enhanced analytics capabilities. The team noted that transitioning to the cloud version allows for quicker access to new features and automatic updates, while the self-hosted version currently lacks these benefits. Product analytics are crucial for evaluating experiments and require integration with customer data pipelines. PepsiCo's current self-hosted setup is limited in analytics, while the cloud provides turnkey solutions. The meeting also highlighted ongoing experimentation efforts at PepsiCo and the need for visibility on features and roadmap to support internal advocacy. The GrowthBook team is committed to enhancing customer support through personalized demos and feedback mechanisms.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, self-hosted, cloud solution, product analytics, A/B testing, feature toggle
